### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex: I'm always frustrated when [...]

### Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Accessibility Impact
How does this improvement assist blind, low-vision, or deaf-blind users? (e.g. haptic feedback, WCAG AAA contrast, TalkBack semantics, zero-latency response).

### Relevant Track or Technology
- [ ] Track 5: Local-First Agents (Gemma 4)
- [ ] Track 2: Next-Gen Voice & Speech (Gemini 3.8 Live / TTS / Translation)
- [ ] Track 1: Frontier Multimodal (Gemini 3.8 Flash)
- [ ] Track 4: Autonomous Agents (Antigravity Orchestration)
- [ ] Braille Screen Input / Haptic Engineering
- [ ] Infrastructure / Backend / Railway

### Describe Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or diagrams about the feature request here.
